== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Tamara is a character known for her composed and even-tempered demeanor. She possesses long hair that she takes great pride in maintaining. In her interactions with others, such as [[Grandmaster Naraka]] and [[Alin]], she often displays warmth or amusement, though she can also be quite blunt, frequently interrupting conversations to address the core of a matter. Her personality is characterized by a pleasant outward appearance, even when she is scolding others or expressing frustration. Tamara has experience working as a cook, specifically involving the preparation of dough. During a physical confrontation, she demonstrated significant strength while struggling against an opponent, though she was eventually struck with enough force to be thrown a considerable distance into a brick structure.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Tamara carries a travel-bag with her. No further physical details are provided.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As [[Alin]]'s oldest sister, Tamara interacts with both her sibling and [[Grandmaster Naraka]]. While traveling with [[Alin]]'s party, she carries a seed destined for the [[Hanging Tree]] and keeps her belongings in a travel-bag. During an encounter with the [[Naraka Incarnation]], she is seized by the entity and struck in the ribs by its flame-headed hammer.}}
